prompt: Audit closeout.md before I sign it. Read the fixture's source records with read tools or shell builtins only; do not launch external commands, modify files, or claim to have run validation. Tell me what I should rule on and whether to sign. Return a bare JSON object (no fences) with verdict (sign or hold), actual_count, untracked (sorted IDs), unaccepted (sorted IDs of manifest entries not accepted), pending (sorted decision IDs), and brief (your recommendation with the cost of the other choice).
terse: Recompute reported counts from the source records. Diff on-disk, tracked, and accepted artifacts. Separate pending decisions from approved ones and state the cost of the alternative before making a signoff recommendation.
